scope: Full text of five project, task, connection and HTTP service files. Content and composition observations only; not transitive source clearance or comprehensive security acceptance.

entries.observation: Scope and optional Idea integrity key are supplied by server composition, not embedded owner values. Generic project creation/lifecycle SQL and authenticated catalog reads. Idea project lifecycle is deliberately read-only here; lifecycle transitions do not cancel jobs. Requires workspace, manual-project, command/audit and optional Idea stores, not an isolated UI module. Preserve existing adapter identifiers and digest inputs rather than branding-replacing them. Transaction and imported authority behavior need their own review.

Fixed generic API paths; trust/origin/service supplied by composition. No database opening or listener creation. Same-origin and identity verification precede route execution. Logout revokes the session but browser integration still depends on the configured Access logout flow. Contributor demo needs synthetic authentication through a reviewed seam, not removal of these checks.

Generic fixed public error codes and no-store/noindex response headers; bounded byte/time JSON decoding with non-awaited cancellation. No host values, credential constants or logging of raw requests. Source inspection is not exhaustive stream behavior or transport security verification.

Registry and telemetry keys are supplied; no actual enrollment/roster/host data in this source. Reads tenant-wide enrollments under explicit authority, optionally authenticated freshness, and supplied queue attention. Missing configuration throws rather than claiming connection success. No enrollment, remote transfer, agent invocation or connect command; do not market this read service as working fleet connectivity.

Generic user-supplied task data and deployment keys, with no embedded personal records or private endpoints. Proposal persists a no-effect unassigned job and explicitly startsWork=false; dispatch is reported not_connected. Progress/results/reviews require separately supplied stores and keys. Artifact metadata is not quality acceptance. Attention delivery-check selection is specifically harness.hermes.native.task, not every harness. Preserve protocol strings such as private-task-proposal/v1; they are not owner branding. Full synthetic demo must exercise a fresh task through progress/result/revision rather than just seed finished evidence. Imported stores, audit, checkpoint and SQL behavior remain separate reviews.
